identity: Like all vampires, the best time to attack it is during the day.  This one won't burn under the sun like true vampires, but it will stop its regeneration. entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of spell 'Henge of Iron Thorns'
identity:
When one of the blood-drinkers of their servants is on verdant ground, you can cause a massive tangle of thorns to grow and imprison them.

This spell still works on other targets, but simply causes bleeding and creates a tangle of thorns, it <color_red>will not</color> restrain them.
